techniques.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/ai_healing.rs:169 healer authors should_retry (parsed at :211); src-tauri/src/engine/healing_retry.rs:947 gates the only verifying re-run on it while :292 already snapshotted the healed prompt as production - a repair ending with the check unrun is never marked unverified
